context.issue_title: ISS-0206: store.zig rowToDefinition leaks on allocation failure — 4 sequential dupes, zero errdefer guards

task.description:
WF-03 Step 3 (BACKEND-DEV: implement fix). Implement ISS-0206 rowToDefinition errdefer cleanup per the validated design at src/design/iss0206-rowtodefinition-errdefer.md. 

## What to implement

1. In src/definition/store.zig:
   - Add a new PRIVATE struct `RowFields` (mirrors the 11 DB columns as plain `[]const u8` / `?[]const u8` slices — see design §4.3).
   - Add a new PRIVATE function `rowToDefinitionFromFields(allocator: std.mem.Allocator, fields: *const RowFields, fallback: CreateParams) error{OutOfMemory}!Definition`. Its body MUST follow the proven parseGraphJson errdefer pattern (store.zig:1318-1421). Specifically:
       * Each fallible dupe lands in a local guarded by its own `errdefer` BEFORE the next fallible statement.
       * The struct literal at the end is assembled LAST (no fallible calls there).
       * `graph.deinit(allocator)` is registered as errdefer regardless of which branch populated it.
   - Refactor existing `rowToDefinition` to become a thin wrapper that fills a `RowFields` from `row: []?[]u8` via the existing `col.get` / `col.getOpt` helpers (unchanged) and delegates to `rowToDefinitionFromFields`.

2. NO caller signature changes (store.zig lines 294, 347, 688, 775, 862, 1067, 1205, 1511, 1542 unchanged).

3. NO new error variants — error set stays `error{OutOfMemory}!Definition`.

4. New allocation-failure regression test file at `src/iss0206_rowtodefinition_errdefer_test.zig` (NB: must live in `src/` due to the module-root constraint — see design §7.1 reasoning mirrored from src/definition_store_test_root.zig). Use `std.testing.checkAllAllocationFailures` against `rowToDefinitionFromFields` with stack-allocated RowFields referencing fixed string slices. Required cases: TC-ISS-0206-01 (all 11 fields populated), TC-ISS-0206-02 (optional fields absent), TC-ISS-0206-03 (regression negative control documented in a comment).

5. Wire the new test target into `build.zig`:
   - Add a new `addTest` target with `root_source_file = b.path("src/iss0206_rowtodefinition_errdefer_test.zig")`.
   - Imports must include `pool` (same as definition_store_tests target — see build.zig:885-895).
   - Attach to BOTH a narrow step (`test-iss0206-rowtodefinition`) AND the aggregate `test_step` (per ISS-0150 / GH #466 lesson — narrow-only is the inert-test defect class).

## Mandatory validation

After implementation, run from terminal and capture output:
  zig build                         # must exit 0
  zig build test                    # must exit 0, no DebugAllocator leak output
  zig build migrate                 # must exit 0
  zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set"  # must produce no output
  python3 tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests   # must exit 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR

If any FAIL: fix the underlying cause. Do not skip; do not lower expectations; do not mask the failure.

## Commit and complete

Once validation passes:
  git add -A
  git commit -m "fix(WF03-GH526): ISS-0206 rowToDefinition errdefer guards (GH #526)"
  git push origin feature/WF03-GH526-20260807

Then complete the handoff per the standard schema (status COMPLETED, result.status PASS, real UTC timestamp for completed_at).

## Anti-patterns (must not violate)

- No SQL string interpolation (out of scope here — store.zig uses prepared statements already).
- No mocks, stubs, in-memory fakes, or stub return values.
- No `error.SkipZigTest` on any MUST test.
- No narrow-step-only test wiring — the new test MUST also attach to the aggregate `test_step`.
- No `catch unreachable` on any realistic failure path.
- No caller signature changes.
